items.text: Let it be — Gavin's one unparsed command ("climb onto the ledge", while standing on it) is idle exploring, not distress; he's safe, unhurried, and was already given a long answer fifteen minutes ago. Speaking again this soon would cheapen the voice. Noted for a build turn: he's stranded at 6/20 with the camp's coal spent and nothing left to do, and he's asking about merchants — the world needs an economy or an ending, not another announcement.
